347:t_1:4.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「...Then you learned Prince $$ユーサー$$'s true intentions.」

347:t_1:5.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「Yes. Once the $$インサラウム$$ people had settled on $$火星$$, Commander $$マルグリット$$ told us.」

347:t_1:6.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「When we learned we'd put all responsibility for the war on the Prince, guilt led every former knight to consider suicide for a time.」

347:t_1:7.en:
$$カレン$$
「Wait a minute! If you did that, everything the Prince did would be wasted!」

347:t_1:8.en:
$$カトル$$
「That would only undo what he gave his life to achieve.」

347:t_1:9.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「Commander $$マルグリット$$ said exactly what you just said.」

347:t_1:10.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「So we abandoned our title and pride as knights, choosing to live on $$火星$$ with $$インサラウム$$'s people, even in shame.」

347:t_1:11.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「We also deeply apologize to you for what happened then.」

347:t_1:12.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「Please raise your heads. ...At least some of us here have no right to condemn you.」

347:t_1:13.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I did the same thing as Prince $$ユーサー$$, yet shamelessly continue to live in disgrace...」

347:t_1:15.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「$$ゼロ$$ and I know we're living in disgrace. Even so, we keep living to do what we must.」

347:t_1:16.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「...You are the same as us, then.」

347:t_1:17.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「You have already atoned. You must not forget your regrets about the past, but you must not abandon the future either.」

347:t_1:19.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「On behalf of our people, I also thank you for offering your condolences for our Prince.」

347:t_1:20.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...By the way, is $$マルグリット$$, the leader of the settlers, not here on $$火星$$?」

347:t_1:24.en:
$$モーム$$
「Weren't you in touch with $$マルグリット$$, $$クロウ$$?」

347:t_1:25.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Listen, $$モーム$$... I told you I was on $$翠の地球$$ all that time.」

347:t_1:26.en:
$$モーム$$
「Would you have contacted her if you'd been on $$蒼の地球$$?」

347:t_1:27.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Ugh... I poked the bush and found an anaconda...」

347:t_1:28.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「$$クロウ$$... $$マルグリット$$ is $$インサラウム$$'s hope, and sacred ground that must not be violated.」

347:t_1:29.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「Even if you were the Prince's worthy rival and recognized each other's worth, if you behave indecently toward her...」

347:t_1:30.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「We men of $$インサラウム$$ are prepared to ride our 《$$ディム・サー$$》s and fight again.」

347:t_1:31.en:
$$クロウ$$
「You still have those $$インサラウム$$ machines?」

347:t_1:32.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「We now belong to the $$地球連邦軍$$, so we use mobile suits for routine missions.」

347:t_1:33.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「But the Federation Assembly approved our continued ownership of $$ディム・サー$$s to preserve our culture.」

347:t_1:34.en:
$$ノイン$$
「The $$連邦政府$$ has done something quite tasteful.」

347:t_1:35.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「We're grateful to the government, but if $$インサラウム$$'s honor is sullied, we'll fight in our $$ディム・サー$$s again.」

347:t_1:36.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I understand. ...Well, there's nothing between $$マルグリット$$ and me for you to worry about.」

347:t_1:37.en:
$$クルツ$$
(I've seen her file. $$マルグリット$$'s a super-hot lady knight, right? I'd dive in wearing nothing but my briefs.)

347:t_1:38.en:
$$デュオ$$
(Guys as hungry as you are a problem, but $$クロウ$$'s cowardice makes me sigh too...)

347:t_1:39.en:
$$カレン$$
「So... Where is $$マルグリット$$ now?」

347:t_1:40.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「Our commander should currently be on Earth.」

347:t_1:41.en:
$$スザク$$
「...She should be...? Haven't you heard from her?」

347:t_1:43.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「But we believe our commander is safe. She's the last $$ハイナイト$$, who kept our hope alive.」

347:t_1:44.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「...Then let me turn to the main topic. Please tell us what you know about $$ＺＯＮＥ$$'s current condition.」

347:t_1:45.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「While carrying out terraforming, we were also surveying this $$火星$$, which was reconstructed by the $$新世時空震動$$.」

347:t_1:46.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「Then, when the $$時の牢獄$$'s destruction caused another fusion of worlds, a new enemy appeared on $$火星$$ too.」

347:t_1:47.en:
$$桂$$
「From how you say that... they sound separate from $$サイデリアル$$.」

347:t_1:48.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「Yes. They were a group originating from Earth humans.」

347:t_1:49.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「While Earth was being attacked by $$サイデリアル$$, we were fighting that enemy here.」

347:t_1:50.en:
$$デュオ$$
「It sounds like you had a rough time too.」

347:t_1:51.en:
$$カトル$$
「What happened with the fight against that enemy?」

347:t_1:52.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「Well... Our standoff continued, but someone destroyed the enemy headquarters, and the fighting ended.」

347:t_1:54.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「The battle occurred during a magnetic storm, so we don't know the details.」

347:t_1:55.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「That enemy called themselves 《$$メガノイド$$s》. Does that mean anything to you?」

347:t_1:57.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「No... I've never heard of them.」

347:t_1:58.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「Around the time those $$メガノイド$$s were wiped out, someone exploited a gap in our surveillance and broke $$ＺＯＮＥ$$'s seal.」

347:t_1:59.en:
$$五飛$$
「Was that connected to whoever defeated the $$メガノイド$$s?」

347:t_1:60.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「We don't know. The garrison only saw a black machine... $$シュロウガ$$, flying away from $$ＺＯＮＥ$$.」

347:t_1:61.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「We immediately reported it to the $$地球連邦$$, but...」

347:t_1:62.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「So the Federation wasn't in a position to address the situation on $$火星$$ either...」

347:t_1:63.en:
$$マオ$$
「Earth had its hands full dealing with $$サイデリアル$$.」

347:t_1:64.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「Unable to bear the situation, Commander $$マルグリット$$ departed for Earth as a messenger herself.」

347:t_1:65.en:
$$トロワ$$
「It seems we passed each other on the way.」

347:t_1:66.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Then we'd like to investigate $$ＺＯＮＥ$$ ourselves. Is that all right?」

347:t_1:67.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「I understand. Leave supplies and the other arrangements to us.」

347:t_1:68.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「The $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ in particular seems to have been pushed very hard. We'll carry out thorough repairs here.」

347:t_1:69.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I'm sorry to impose. You're taking care of everything for us.」

347:t_1:70.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「No... We're compatriots now, so please don't hesitate to ask.」

347:t_1:71.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「And that $$アサキム・ドーウィン$$ is also the enemy who took our Prince and $$インサラウム$$'s greatest treasure, $$ジ・インサー$$, from us.」

347:t_1:72.en:
$$ＡＳ団員$$
「We have no right to ask this of you, but our late Prince's unfulfilled wish...」

347:t_1:73.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「I promise we will do our best.」

347:t_1:74.en:
$$クロウ$$
(Are you watching, $$ユーサー$$...? Everyone you loved still loves you.)

347:t_1:75.en:
$$クロウ$$
(Your water jar never runs dry, nourishing $$インサラウム$$'s people. So leave what comes next to us, and rest easy.)

347:t_1:82.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I didn't expect anyone to be here.」

347:t_1:84.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I came to this red planet of war to see the end fools meet.」

347:t_1:85.en:
???
「You mean the $$メガノイド$$s... No... the $$クロノ$$ Reformists.」
